def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    base = list(grid[0])
    period = next(p for p in range(1, len(base) + 1)
                 if all(base[i] == base[i % p] for i in range(len(base))))
    return [[base[(c + 1) % period] if c < r else base[c]
             for c in range(len(base))] for r in range(n)]
